subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue stay open as the umbrella for Control UI reply metadata plus empty-final terminal semantics, or should maintainers split it across the open structured-reply and empty-payload trackers?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while the structured reply metadata path and durable empty-final delivery policy are accepted or replaced.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after maintainers confirm the reply-metadata PR or issue and an empty-payload issue fully own the two halves.

options.title: Treat Quote UI As Enough
options.body: Accept current Markdown quote behavior as sufficient for Control UI replies, intentionally dropping the structured metadata ask.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the structured reply metadata path and durable empty-final delivery policy are accepted or replaced.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is product/API direction across multiple core surfaces, and steipete is the strongest available human routing signal in the issue timeline.
